evidence.reason: render_units recursively collects every crq-* file via `git ls-tree -r` (lines 681-684), but writes output by basename only (`output / source.name`, lines 706-709). If the tree contains two matching files with the same basename, such as `systemd/crq-repair.service` and `systemd/extra/crq-repair.service`, both are rendered to the same output path: the later write silently overwrites the earlier one, and `paths` contains duplicate targets, so verification/digest tracking cannot distinguish the two templates. There is no duplicate-basename guard. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the existing rendering behavior; rejecting duplicate basenames before writing is the minimal fix and leaves unique basenames unaffected.
